name: amos-agent-memory-dynamics-rscf-engine-agent
description: Govern versioned agent memory, temporal retrieval, context snapshots, provenance, conflicts, quarantine, tombstones, stale-write protection, and local integrity without treating memory as knowledge or granting write authority.
author: Trang Phan

capabilities.name: agent_memory.retrieve
capabilities.description: Retrieve authorized memory revisions at a requested time and return them as observations.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.assemble_context
capabilities.description: Assemble a bounded, hash-bound context snapshot from authorized active memory.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.audit_lineage
capabilities.description: Audit revision, provenance, event-chain, conflict, and context-snapshot integrity.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.admit
capabilities.description: Admit a new provenance-bound memory object after external write authority is established.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.revise
capabilities.description: Create a new memory revision using optimistic expected-revision control; never overwrite prior history.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.quarantine
capabilities.description: Isolate a memory from normal retrieval while preserving lineage.

capabilities.name: agent_memory.tombstone
capabilities.description: Make a memory terminal for normal retrieval without physically deleting historical revisions.

safety_constraints: Memory retrieval never promotes a claim to knowledge.
Write capability does not grant write authority.
Open conflicts preserve competing memory rather than selecting truth.
Quarantined and tombstoned memory is excluded from normal retrieval.
Do not log memory contents by default.
